shortDescription: Module to manage external providers in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: authentication_keys
options.description: List of authentication keys. When you will not pass these keys and there are already some of them defined in the system they will be removed. Applicable for I(os_volume).

options.name: authentication_url
options.description: Keystone authentication URL of the openstack provider. Applicable for those types: I(os_image), I(os_volume) and I(network).

options.name: data_center
options.description: Name of the data center where provider should be attached. Applicable for those type: I(os_volume).

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the external provider to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: network_type
options.description: Type of the external network provider either external (for example OVN) or neutron. Applicable if C(type) is I(network).

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user specified in C(username) parameter. Applicable for all types.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: read_only
options.description: Specify if the network should be read only. Applicable if C(type) is I(network).

options.name: state
options.description: Should the external be present or absent When you are using absent for I(os_volume), you need to make sure that SD is not attached to the data center!

options.name: tenant_name
options.description: Name of the tenant. Applicable for those types: I(os_image), I(os_volume) and I(network).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: url
options.description: URL where external provider is hosted. Applicable for those types: I(os_image), I(os_volume), I(network) and I(foreman).

options.name: username
options.description: Username to be used for login to external provider. Applicable for all types.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
